# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The single source of truth for project instructions is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read it before making changes.

Context-specific instructions live next to the code, e.g. [dotnet/AGENTS.md](../dotnet/AGENTS.md) and [ts/apps/cooquoi-webapp/AGENTS.md](../ts/apps/cooquoi-webapp/AGENTS.md).

Do not add project knowledge here — update `AGENTS.md` instead.
